component.name: Outlook for Linux
component.summary: Unofficial Microsoft Outlook client for Linux

description.p: Use Outlook on the web (Microsoft 365 or Outlook.com) as a standalone desktop application with tray unread count, desktop notifications and mailto: link handling.
This application is an unofficial client and is not affiliated with Microsoft. It is based on Teams for Linux.

ul.li: initial Outlook for Linux, forked from Teams for Linux 2.22.0

codeql: grant actions: read for the private repository
